primary_affinity: CPU 8, one physical core, one inference thread
compiler: Clang/LLVM 23.1.5; Nix Clang 23.1.3 wrapper and resource headers from repository flake
backend: CPU only; native ISA, repacking and llamafile enabled; OpenMP unavailable/disabled; no GPU or BLAS
proof: Exact integer slice; every Val 32 including poison; defined input returns 32 defined bytes, each 0 for a set bit and 240 for an unset bit.
proof_axioms: Standard three and 32 recomputed bv_decide axioms
alive2: Bidirectional, --disable-undef-input; full-undef attempt timed out and is not counted as validation
notes: All original timing pairs retained, including large outliers; host was not isolated.
Session medians and pooled ratios describe this workload and target, not other thread counts or machines.
Only Q5 bitspread is in the measured target. Nibble and Q8 guard are separate exploratory variants.
Original measured target relowered unchanged repack as a control; packaged target reuses the original repack object. All allocated target ELF sections except build-id and full disassembly agree.
